sql: select to_char(at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') at_utc, balance_cents, coalesce(residual_cents::text,'-') residual, coalesce(fills_counted::text,'-') fills, coalesce(settlements_counted::text,'-') setl, coalesce(presumed_transfer::text,'-') ptx, coalesce(notes_json::text,'null') notes from incentive_balance_observations order by at desc, id desc limit 8
